basis.sourceLimitation: Standard MIDI does not preserve print staff/hand identity or print stem direction.

chordPolicy.equalQuantizedOnset: one chord event; do not split equal-onset chord tones into inferred voices

voicePartition.scope: per source track/channel and per derived measure
voicePartition.reuseRule: assign an onset-group to an already available action whose prior event ends no later than the new onset
reusePreference: minimum absolute anchor-pitch distance from the action's previous sounding event
voicePartition.newAction: create a new derived action only when no existing action is available

inAccordOrdering.actionAnchor: first sounding event's highest MIDI pitch within the measure
tieBreak: highest pitch encountered in the measure descending
inAccordOrdering.rationale: Use one deterministic generic-MIDI branch without claiming recovered treble/bass identity; it also aligns with the existing generic MIDI chord profile's highest-written/downward orientation.

deferred.partMeasureInAccord: later H4D if required by incomplete/sectional measures
deferred.nestedInAccord: later only with explicit need and conformance tests
deferred.crossedVoiceOriginalOrdering: not recoverable from MIDI without print semantics
deferred.userStaffOverride: future optional SDK extension; not required for H4C

failurePolicy.incompleteMeasureNeedingPolyphony: fail closed until part-measure in-accord support exists

next: H4C materialize full-measure in-accord reconstruction with deterministic generic-MIDI voice partition and explicit diagnostics
